An '''agri-kit'''<ref name="GG1">''[[Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope]]''</ref> or '''agricultural tool kit'''<ref name="TLCSB">''[[The Last Command Sourcebook]]''</ref> was used to tend agricultural projects. [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]] of the [[Wayland Herd]] used them,<ref name="Iggjel" /> as did [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] Elder [[Ovkhevam]].<ref name="TLCSB" />
